title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot of $$z$$ vs $$y$$. Notice the pattern of the data points. Does it resemble a linear, quadratic, or another type of relationship?

title: Identifying the Pattern
text: The scatterplot shows a curve that appears to be increasing at an increasing rate. This suggests a non-linear relationship between $$z$$ and $$y$$.

title: Choosing the Right Transformation
text: To linearize the relationship, consider transformations that can straighten the curve. Common transformations include taking the square root, logarithm, or cube of the variables.

title: Applying Transformations
text: Try applying different transformations to $$y$$ to see which one results in a linear relationship with $$z$$. Consider transformations like $$\sqrt{y}$$, $$\ln\left(y\right)$$, or $$y^3$$.
